rows.gloss: cappanga id. /Said to be < Malay sěpang or Minangkabau sapang; but Hooker takes the tree to be native in India as well as in 'Malay isles.' Hobson-Jobson (s. v. sappan-wood) suggests that the tree is indigenous in Mababar, Deccan, and Malay Peninsula and the name good Dravidian, whence Indonesia has borrowed.
